**3.6h**

I started by finishing the connections for the components that I had already placed, then I added some more components and learned some concepts, while applying them too, those being the Balun, LPF and matching, and learned why they were needed, for example, LPF filters some noise so it makes the antenna not spit out garbage that would mess with other devices around it. then I connected everything and started making the pcb.

### 2026-11-09: I started by laying out the RF components and ordering them so that they would be close together and make it really close between the pins, then I created the ground plane, in this case earth, being t

**6.4h**

I started by laying out the RF components and ordering them so that they would be close together and make it really close between the pins, then I created the ground plane, in this case earth, being the same as gnd. then I connected them together and also to the pico. Then I created another plane for the raspberry pi also being a gnd so that it would connect all the components near it, I also added my specific components to make the project truly mine, then I assigned the footprints, connected them to the pico and created a lot of vias so that the skin effect and others wouldnt affect the transmission and pcb, I also calculated the transmission line in the end.
